description: This file defines the 'UnitConversion' class in the Coocook schema, representing unit conversion relationships with methods for reversing conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::UnitConversion
classes.description: Represents a unit conversion with properties for units involved, conversion factor, and comments, including a method to reverse the conversion.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the unit conversion by swapping units and inverting the factor.
